family: The single total language L of proof.md section 1, decided at every length N by one fixed evaluator A. If N<16 output 0. Else k is the largest integer with 4^k<=N, t=2^k, m0=floor((N-t)/(t+1)), m=m0 if m0 is odd and m=m0-1 otherwise, l=N-t-m-t*m; if m<1 output 0. Bits 1..t define R(W)=W^t+sum_{v<t} x_{v+1}W^v and bits t+1..t+m define Q(Z)=Z^m+sum_{u<m} x_{t+u+1}Z^u over F_2; if R or Q fails the exact irreducibility test of proof.md (X^(2^d)=X mod P, and gcd(P,X^(2^d')-X)=1 for every divisor d' of d=deg P with d'<d) output 0. Otherwise the next t*m bits c_{u,v} (bit number t+m+v*m+u+1) give z=sum c_{u,v}Z^uW^v in the field E=(F_2[Z]/(Q))[W]/(R) with 2^(tm) elements, the last l bits are ignored, and the output is 1 iff z^e=1 for e=sum_{j=0}^{t-1} 2^(m*j). All t+m+l prefix and leftover bits are counted in N; R and Q are input, not advice.
theorem: A runs in polynomial time on every input, so L is in P; L is in NP with witness bound W(N)=0 and the fixed verifier V that accepts (x,w) iff w is empty and A(x)=1. In the full pinned B2 model, with N the entire input length: for every integer N>=2^200, C_B2(L_N)>=(159039/34039)*N-(70379/2)*N/(log2 N)^2. Consequently liminf over all integers N of C_B2(L_N)/N >= 159039/34039. Proof: proof.md, with circuit.md, cutwidth.md, certificate.md, krs.md; Proposition C is established by the declared experiment certify (certify.py), whose method and error analysis are in certificate.md.
